style_rules.color_balance: Approximate60/30/10 visual hierarchy: oat #F5F1E7 dominant, apricot #E4C5AF secondary, loud coral #FF5738 selectively emphasized. This is a design allocation, not a measured whole-page pixel statistic.
style_rules.hero: Light oat scene with an apricot field exactly30percent of the stage width. Dark Manrope Teacher title and a slightly tilted coral Forever-student strip; dark ink on coral. Selected identity and primary actions use coral.
style_rules.secondary_areas: Apricot photographic spread, manifesto and footer surfaces support the predominantly oat reading page. Quiet brown/rust contour strokes replace blue lines. Student mode moves the apricot field to the left on a cream #F3E9DC ground.
style_rules.type: One locally packaged Manrope variable font, weight200–800. Reading400, labels500, large headings600–650. No serif or faux italic on major headings. Legacy CSS font tokens point to Manrope to preserve architecture.
style_rules.contrast: Normal text #24221F, secondary #584D43, text links and focus #8F2D1B. Loud coral surfaces #FF5738 use dark #24221F text. White is retained only on dark hover surfaces. Primary button file-size labels inherit their dark parent text.
style_rules.opening: Existing finite2.6second name/iris sequence retained. Manrope upright first name550, surname600; warm paper mask, coral ring and skip control.
style_rules.photo_lens: Existing pointer/tap curiosity lens retained. Oat or cream image scrims protect dark foreground text; the actual approved gallery image is unchanged. Same loop, lifecycle and motion preference controls.
style_rules.font_source: Verified shared-library google-manrope entry; unmodified164700byte variable TTF SHA256 3ae11c49db0455a3cc33e37d380f20fdb8c7f8b41dc07625c177e3d87a9d6ae6. Full copyright/OFL notice packaged. No remote font request or system installation.
